message: As we think about preparedness, it can be helpful to approach it with a cozy mindset. 🏡 This resource offers practical safety skills that can turn our planning into a collaborative family event. By learning together, we not only build our readiness but also create moments of connection, sharing laughs and stories along the way. Let’s turn these preparations into a fun family project. How do you make your safety planning feel more like a gathering than a chore?
